This repository contains a Vite + React project used for a symposium grading app. The setup includes Tailwind CSS for styling. The main entry point is `src/main.jsx` and `App.jsx`.

The `README.md` provides basic instructions to install dependencies and run the development server. A VS Code task named "npm: dev" launches `npm run dev`.

When contributing, ensure the Tailwind configuration in `tailwind.config.js` is updated and any new components import the CSS.
